verdict_reason: Fixture migration to commodityCode/speciesLatinName is correct against rules.js (horseName gated on 0101), but the renamed fixture needs a comment to decode it, the header comments narrate history, and the set-up is copied from commit-purge-authority.test.js.

todos.issue: STALE_0102_LINE (renamed in this PR from STALE_COW_LINE) needs the comment on lines 17-18 to decode it: the name gives a bare commodity code and the word 'stale', but not that the fixture is a cattle line carrying a horseName that 0102 does not scope. The comment also restates the obligation rule from services/commodities/rules.js (horseName is gated on 0101), which the house rules forbid (a comment describes only the lines below it, never another module)
todos.fix: Must: the fixture name says what the fixture holds (a 0102 line with a horseName it does not scope), and the lines 17-18 comment is gone. One way: rename to CATTLE_LINE_WITH_HORSE_NAME (and HORSE_LINE stays), then delete the comment

todos.issue: Lines 14-15 narrate history and describe other modules: 'Every entry mutation now rebuilds and evaluates the canonical snapshot. These tests pin that the old stale-answer window has closed.' ('now', 'old ... window has closed'). The file name entry-write-purge-window.test.js carries the same history word ('window')
todos.fix: Must: no comment in the file narrates a before/after or describes the write pipeline, and the file name states the behaviour under test rather than the closed defect. One way: delete lines 14-15 and rename the file to something like entry-write-purge.test.js, matching its describe 'entry-write canonical purge'

todos.issue: Lines 47-65 (journeyId, buildRequest, seed, durable, wipeOf and the beforeEach that configures records/session stubs and creates a journey) are a verbatim copy of commit-purge-authority.test.js lines 34-50. Set-up used by two tests belongs in engine/test-support.js
todos.fix: Must: one shared helper in engine/test-support.js owns the purge-test set-up (seed, durable read-back, wipe set, stub configuration and journey creation), and both test files call it with no local copies left. One way: export a purgeTestJourney() factory from test-support.js returning { seed, durable, wipeOf, buildRequest } after configuring the stubs, and use it in both files
